metadata.target_origin: unchanged observed target from the existing full-day example
metadata.desired_loss_scope: assistant content only; must be implemented by the future trainer
known_limitations: Only fields in the illustrative profile fragment are included.
Profile availability date and individual event-notice availability are not certified here.
Clock labels are preserved without inferring a UTC offset.
